title: Output written in two places in the program
summary: An output follows only the last assignment in the scan; earlier logic appears to have no effect.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: An output follows only the last assignment in the scan; earlier logic appears to have no effect.

troubleshooting.effect: Logic that should switch an output is ignored
symptoms: The output reacts to one condition but not another
evidence: Cause-and-effect view: committed value at the end of the scan
diagnosticMethod: Search all assignments of the output
repair: Combine the conditions into one assignment
troubleshooting.explanation: Within one scan only the final value of an output is written to the output image.
